name: lms-csrf-failures
description: Count CSRF verification failures in LMS logs (often indicates cookie/CSRF trusted origins drift).
filter: resource.type="k8s_container" AND resource.labels.namespace_name="mereka-lms" AND resource.labels.container_name="lms" AND (textPayload=~"CSRF verification failed" OR textPayload=~"Forbidden \(CSRF" OR jsonPayload.message=~"CSRF verification failed")
